target.title: fix(telegram): show typing for accepted topic messages
target.body:
Related: #92287

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users sending addressed Telegram forum-topic messages could see no immediate typing/progress signal while OpenClaw was accepting the message and preparing the agent turn. In busy operational topics this made accepted follow-up messages look dropped, especially when the final response was delayed by context/session setup.

It also makes skipped require-mention group messages easier to diagnose by logging the Telegram message id and forum thread id with the existing skip reason.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Telegram plugin already has a native early typing cue for direct chats after access/body validation, but accepted group/forum topic messages waited until later reply execution paths. This change reuses the existing `sendTyping()` helper and only starts the cue after the inbound message is classified as a non-`room_event` user request, preserving quiet ambient-room behavior and require-mention safety.

This is intentionally complementary to #92287: that PR handles queued follow-up / dispatch typing policy, while this one covers the Telegram message-context intake path and adds targeted skip diagnostics.

## User Impact

Users in Telegram forum topics get prompt native typing feedback for messages OpenClaw has actually accepted. Operators also get enough log context (`messageId` and `threadId`) to distinguish ignored require-mention traffic from accepted-but-slow work without guessing from screenshots.

Ambient room events and unaddressed require-mention messages remain quiet.

## Evidence

- `OPENCLAW_HEAVY_CHECK_LOCK_SCOPE=worktree node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/telegram/src/bot-message-context.typing.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot-message-context.require-mention.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot-message-context.body.test.ts` — 44 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/telegram/src/bot-message-context.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot-message-context.body.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot-message-context.typing.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot-message-context.body.test.ts` — 0 warnings / 0 errors.
- `OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 OPENCLAW_CHANGED_LANES_RAW_SYNC=1 CI=1 PNPM_CONFIG_VERIFY_DEPS_BEFORE_RUN=false OPENCLAW_HEAVY_CHECK_LOCK_SCOPE=worktree corepack pnpm check:changed` — passed changed extension lanes.
